verdicts.typography: Flawless typographic hierarchy. The mono uppercase micro-labels (e.g., 'GLOBAL LANDSCAPE', 'THE FIELD', stat strip labels) are perfectly disciplined. Heading scale is rhythmic, weight contrast is sharp, and there is zero orphaned or cramped text visible across all desktop screenshots.
verdicts.color: Excellent minimalist discipline with a single restrained red accent used consistently for emphasis, the logo, and the final matrix column. One minor nitpick: in d3-matrix, the red square marks for 'CORE CAPABILITY' appear to use a very slightly different red saturation or opacity compared to the pure red used for the 'THIS SYSTEM' header and the hero accent—barely perceptible but visible under close inspection.
verdicts.layout: Publication-grade Swiss grid alignment. The max-w container is consistent, whitespace rhythm is generous and precise, all hairline borders are intact with no double-border artifacts, and the footer is correctly pinned at the document bottom as seen in d8-footer.
verdicts.components: High-quality component execution. The matrix table legibility is excellent, the sticky first column works perfectly (proven in d9-matrix-scrolled), and the accordion affordances are clear. One deductible defect: in d3-matrix, the outer right border of the final 'THIS SYSTEM' column appears slightly thicker than the 2px left rule, creating a minor visual imbalance in the table's bounding box.
verdicts.responsive: Flawless mobile and dark-mode execution. Mobile layout at 390px maintains integrity with no overflow or clipped text; the wide matrix table handles horizontal scrolling correctly, including sticky first-column behavior. Dark-mode palette is consistent across all sections (Hero, Matrix, Field) with high contrast and correct color inversion for accents.

color: In d3-matrix, ensure the red fill color of the 'CORE CAPABILITY' checkbox squares exactly matches the hex/RGB value used for the 'THIS SYSTEM' header text and the hero accent red to guarantee absolute color consistency.
components: In d3-matrix, adjust the outer border-right width of the final 'THIS SYSTEM' column to match the precise 2px weight of its left rule, ensuring symmetrical visual weight on the table's closing edge.
